rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=140, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-10 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). CLEAN DOCUMENTATION ITER toward iter-20: confirm the classical-TV FBP-ceiling. BASE_ITER=4 (the BEST family: clip 0.08, lambda 0.001, lr 0.01). ONE KNOB vs iter-4: tv_iterations 160->140 -- because iter-4 measured 1227.4s at 160 iters, OVER the 1200s HARD wall (metric-invalid by budget); 140 iters is the budget-PROVEN wall-safe count that already reproduced the ceiling at iter-8 (1063.7s, ~136s margin). The solver is DETERMINISTIC: NO training, NO seed axis, recon fully determined by (tv_lambda, tv_iterations, tv_lr, tv_clip_max); given an identical config the result is bit-identical. LEVER MAP -- all four live knobs in tv_reconstruction() MAPPED + EXHAUSTED: (1) tv_clip_max was THE lever (iter-1 0.05->iter-2 0.08 lifted hr 0.133->0.205 by un-truncating high-mu bone) but pushing to 0.10 in iter-9 went FLAT (0.2054) -- the 0.08 clamp already passes all real Mayo attenuation, lever un-binds above 0.08. (2) tv_lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 -- up@0.003 (iter-3, 0.1366) and down@0.0005 (iter-6, 0.1582) BOTH regress. (3) tv_lr BRACKETED at 0.01 -- up-2x@0.02 (iter-5, 0.1873) overshoots, up-1.3x@0.013 (iter-7, 0.2082) flat. (4) tv_iterations: 120@918s(hr0.2054)/140@1064s(hr0.2078)/160@1227s(hr0.2085, OVER WALL) -- the +0.003 hr from 120->160 is within noise AND the 160 count is budget-illegal; the budget-safe band caps at ~0.208. There is GENUINELY no untried in-budget lever left that changes the deterministic result. HYPOTHESIS: hr ~= 0.208 (reproduce iter-8 0.2078 @140 iters within run-to-run noise), documenting ~0.208 hr / ~0.926 SSIM as the STRUCTURAL classical-TV FBP-ceiling on dense (2304-view) real Mayo LDCT. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: this solver is deterministic, so if hr deviates materially from the prior 140-iter result (|hr - 0.2078| >> run-noise, say > 0.005), that signals NON-DETERMINISM in the pipeline (GPU-nondeterministic reduction, FOV-mask/load drift) rather than a real recon change, and must be investigated -- NOT treated as a tuning gain. BUDGET: tv_iterations=140 is wall-safe (iter-8 measured 1063.7s, 89pct of 1200s, ~136s margin; cost model 30 + 140*7.48 = 1077s; at +10pct GPU-contention variance ~1182s, STILL under the HARD wall). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net above the 20-min metric-validity budget.
